messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the Q3 hiring ramp and org shifts. Lots of great Qs in the Q&A queue — I'll capture them here and link a short playbook.

Jonas (CTO): Short summary: were reallocating to prioritize runtime, eng-platform, and devex. Goal: ~45 net-adds in Q3. Split roughly 60% eng, 25% product/ops, 15% go-to-market/support. Focus on senior infra ICs for throughput resilience.

Tom (ENG Manager - Runtime): For my team: I have 3 backfills after two departures. Any SLA for backfill approvals?

Maya (People Ops): Tom  backfills that match an approved headcount slot: aim to post & approve within 5 business days. If you're re-banding (e.g., L3 -> L4), submit a 1-2 line rationale (impact + budget) and tag @Sahil for approval.

Sahil (VP Eng): To echo: band structure mostly unchanged but bar for senior IC/EM clarified. Hiring guidance: runtime hires default to L4/L5; product-facing roles default L3/L4. Exceptions need manager note + @Maya sign-off.

Elliot (Recruiter): Sourcing plan: my team starts active outreach Mon. Please attach the correct scorecard code when creating GH reqs: `Q3_INFRA_SRIC`. Add interviewer names early so we can schedule loops quickly.

Lina (Hiring Manager - DevEx): Onboarding question: what does standard ramp look like for L4/L5? Can we get a checklist?

Maya (People Ops): Will post full checklist to handbook. Quick starter template:
```
Week 1: Accounts, laptop + entitlements, team intro
Week 2: Pairing on small bug, infra walkthroughs
Weeks 3-4: Ownership of minor task + architecture deep-dive
Weeks 5-8: Deliver a small feature, 1:1 growth plan
```
I'll upload the detailed checklist to /handbook/hiring by EOD tomorrow.

Tom (ENG Manager - Runtime): Interviewing logistics: can teams do shadow loops for calibration?

Sahil (VP Eng): Yes. Managers should sit in at least one of the first 4 loops for any hire on their team. We'll run a 30-min calibration session Mon 9am PT. Invite coming from Elliot.

Jonas (CTO): Messaging guidance for external partners: use "Q3 hiring ramp focused on infra & platform". Avoid language like "hiring spree" or "urgent hire" in public recruiter postings. This is a measured ramp tied to capacity needs.

Elliot (Recruiter): Noted. I'll standardize the external blurb and update agency partners.

Maya (People Ops): Internal mobility: transfers <2 bands use the internal transfer flow (no new req). Transfers >=2 bands require People Ops sign-off. Managers: include a 2-bullet growth plan when requesting a transfer.

Lina (Hiring Manager - DevEx): For managers running multiple loops, any scorecard changes?

Sahil (VP Eng): Minor tweak: add a line to scorecards about "systems thinking for scale" for infra roles. I'll drop the exact phrasing in GH templates today.

Maya (People Ops): I'll assemble a one-pager: approvals SLA, posting tag, onboarding checklist link, internal transfer flow link. Will post to handbook & share here when live. DM me for urgent cases.

hr-bot: New doc posted -> https://handbook.redwood.ai/hiring/q3-hiring-playbook (doc id: 309)

Tom (ENG Manager - Runtime): Thanks all. Will prioritize panels & get reqs up this afternoon.

Lina (Hiring Manager - DevEx): Thanks Maya  very helpful :clap:
